standard.summary: 高级覆盖：省显存 attention（比 xformers 更省显存但更慢）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: An advanced override: memory-efficient attention (saves more VRAM than xformers but is slower).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 高级覆盖：省显存 attention（比 xformers 更兼容，通常更慢）。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Advanced override: memory-efficient attention (more compatible than xformers, usually slower). Off by default.
